learnings.title: Shopify Product Insights is not available in the Shopify mobile app
learnings.claim: On 2026-10-28, the official Shopify Help Product insights page explicitly states that Product insights is not currently available for the Shopify app. The 90-day product view is reached from Shopify admin > Products > product details > Insights > View details and includes net sales, channel breakdown, net units by traffic source and first-time versus returning customers. This corrects the 2026-10-03 historical learning that the fetched page did not document app unavailability; it does not prove access to any specific store.
learnings.decision: PRODUCT_INSIGHTS_APP_SURFACE_GATE: For video_shopify product-demand checks, do not claim the Shopify mobile app exposes Product Insights. Use an authorized Shopify admin product details page when available; require verified net sales and net units rather than traffic or virality. If the authorized admin surface is unavailable, mark Product Insights data N/A and do not invent store values.
learnings.next_measurement: At the next authorized Shopify product review, verify Product Insights access from admin product details and record whether 90-day net sales, net units by traffic source, channel and first-time/returning metrics are available; no account access is implied by the public Help page.
failure_history: Historical learn_f0de38014bef7448 was untagged for video_shopify and said the fetched 2026-10-03 Help page did not document app unavailability; the official page checked 2026-10-28 now explicitly states the limitation. Preserve the historical record.
fallback_history: If Shopify admin product insights are unavailable or not authorized, use verified orders, sales, returns, landed cost, margin, trust, policy and seasonality; never infer product demand from public video views.
